subject: Post-call: Context-length cost profile & pilot proposal
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Torres <maria@novablue.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Context-length cost profile & pilot proposal

Hi Maria — great conversation earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and asks so we can size a tailored pilot: 

Summary of what I heard (please correct if I misremember):
- Primary product flows: document ingestion + assisted authoring for compliance and sales enablement.
- Expected steady-state traffic: ~25k MAUs with heavy sessions producing 1–3 LLM calls per session.
- Your preliminary token mix: you estimated ~30M tokens/month total.
- Context and length profile: average prompt tokens ~1,200, avg completion tokens ~800; heavy document flows need an 8k window for most cases, ~10% of calls need 32k windows (section-level extraction), and rare long-form legal assembly (~1% of calls) may need 128k.
- Procurement target: keep baseline unit economics below ~$80 / 1M tokens if possible.

Open items we promised to confirm:
1) Exact monthly token volume tolerance (you mentioned 30M but said you’d validate with analytics team).
2) Percent of calls that are retrieval-heavy (where prompt tokens spike) vs. short inference outputs.
3) Any hard constraints from procurement on pilot commitment or required security artifacts.

Immediate proposal from our side:
- 3-month pilot: up to 30M tokens/month (rolling), Redwood provides a dedicated pilot config with autoscaling and 30-day cost telemetry.
- Pricing scaffolding (ballpark for planning only): baseline model (8k optimized) at $85 / 1M tokens; 32k model variants billed at a higher per-1M (we estimate $140 / 1M); 128k on-demand variant at $320 / 1M. We also expect to reduce effective cost via caching & batching; for retrieval-heavy workloads effective $/1M could be 15–30% lower after tuning.

Attachments: I’m attaching a quick token analysis CSV (sample-token-analysis.csv) that shows cost sensitivity by avg prompt/completion mixes — we used the session numbers you gave on the call as a starting point.

Next steps I propose:
- Maria: confirm the 30M/month and the 10% / 1% splits for 32k/128k so we can firm up numbers.
- Procurement: please share any procurement templates or hard ceilings for $/1M.
- Redwood: we’ll send an official pilot SOW + pilot configuration and a short demo of the 32k handling in our console.

Available to hop on another 30-minute call early next week if helpful.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Maria Torres <maria@novablue.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Lee <devon.lee@novablue.ai>, procurement@novablue.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 16:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Context-length cost profile & pilot proposal

Thanks Lauren — good summary. A few clarifications after checking with analytics and product: 
- Confirmed monthly baseline: ~30M tokens/month (give or take 10%) based on current staging traffic; we can scale with a committed purchase if the pilot proves out.
- Token breakdown (measured across last 30 days): average prompt tokens per call: 900 (we saw a 75th percentile around 1,800 for long retrieval prompts), average completion tokens per call: ~1,500.
- Window needs: ~85% of calls fit within 8k, ~10% require 32k windows (document section extraction & multi-doc synth), and ~1%–2% require 128k for full-policy assembly (legal). The rest are edge cases.
- Strict procurement note: their preferred target is <= $75 / 1M tokens for baseline model economics, but they are open to tiered pricing for larger windows if the pilot shows measurable value.

I’ve looped Devon (Head of Platform) and procurement on the thread — procurement will send the standard vendor form and required security attestations.

Thanks for the CSV — I’ll take a look and get you the raw analytics slice by EOD Monday.

-Maria
Maria Torres
VP Product, NovaBlue
maria@novablue.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Apr 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Context-length cost profile & pilot proposal

Lauren — quick internal note (forwarding my thoughts to you):

On the numbers Maria provided, we should structure the pilot to de-risk procurement and protect margin: 
- Suggested pilot pricing cadence:
  * Pilot committed volume: 30M tokens/month for 3 months.
  * Baseline (8k path): $85 / 1M tokens for the pilot (intro rate).
  * 32k window variant: $140 / 1M tokens.
  * 128k on-demand: $300 / 1M tokens and recommend strict approval gate to avoid runaway spend.

- Engineering levers to lower effective cost: enable prefix/KV caching for repeated retrievals, 1.5–2x batching at the inference layer for background jobs, and a quantized mid-tier model for retrieval-heavy operations. Expecting 20–30% reduction in effective $/1M after tuning.
- Risk mitigations: cap monthly spend in the pilot, telemetry dashboard with daily alerts for token velocity, and a simple rollback policy to 8k-only if 128k consumption exceeds 1.5% of total.

Actionable asks for the external thread:
1) Get procurement’s vendor form and any hard $/1M ceiling.
2) Ask NovaBlue to validate the 32k / 128k percentages against product logs (Maria said she’ll share).
3) Draft a 3-month SOW + pilot terms (I can help with the pricing table language).

If procurement insists on <=$75/1M for baseline, we can still pilot at $85 but offer a volume-backed rebate if moving to an annual commit.

-Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Torres <maria@novablue.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-call: Context-length cost profile & pilot proposal

Thanks all — aligning on next steps: 

1) Maria / Devon / procurement: please send the vendor form and any absolute budget ceilings. Once we have those, we’ll finalize SOW pricing.
2) Redwood will circulate a draft SOW (3-month pilot, up to 30M tokens/month) and an itemized pricing table including the baseline, 32k, and 128k tiers. We’ll include a daily telemetry dashboard and a spend cap.
3) Proposed timeline:
   - Draft SOW & pilot config: by Tue 24 Apr 2028
   - Procurement review: Wed 25 Apr
   - Kickoff & demo of 32k flow: Fri 27 Apr

We’ve created the HubSpot deal record and added an initial quote (link below). If that timeline works, I’ll follow up with a short DocuSign stub for signature on the SOW.

HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/784512/DEAL-NB-2028-0420-01
DocuSign (stub): https://www.docusign.com/stub/nb-pilot-quote

Thanks — we’ll aim to keep pilot baseline priced close to procurement’s target; Ben will prepare margin-preserving rebate language in case NovaBlue converts to an annual commit.
